verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has an official MCP server connecting to AI agents (Claude, Cursor) allowing natural-language commands like "Create an email campaign promoting our Memorial Day sale," plus a Composer AI feature that builds audiences/content from natural-language prompts. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of MCP server reliability, no llms.txt for broader agent discoverability, and no detail on breadth of commands supported beyond campaign creation examples.
